name: Glycemic Control Threshold (HbA1c)
description: HbA1c must remain within 4.0-5.6% for non-diabetic compliance; 5.7-6.4% pre-diabetic alert; ≥6.5% diagnostic flag.
semantic_fingerprint: hba1c glycemic glucose diabetes metabolic blood sugar glycated haemoglobin

derivation_formula.name: ADAG_Nathan
derivation_formula.description: Average glucose estimated from HbA1c (Nathan 2008). eAG = 28.7*HbA1c - 46.7

xai_narrator_hint: HbA1c>7.0% indicates suboptimal glycaemic control — evaluate insulin regimen and dietary compliance.

name: Blood Pressure Safety Boundary
description: Systolic BP must be <130 mmHg and diastolic <80 mmHg for optimal cardiovascular compliance.
semantic_fingerprint: blood pressure systolic diastolic hypertension cardiovascular SBP DBP

name: Renal Function Adequacy (eGFR)
description: eGFR ≥90 mL/min/1.73m² indicates normal kidney function. <60 signals chronic kidney disease stage 3+.
semantic_fingerprint: egfr kidney renal creatinine glomerular filtration CKD

derivation_formula.name: CKD_EPI_2021
derivation_formula.description: CKD-EPI 2021 eGFR (race-free). For Cr-based: eGFR = 142 * min(Cr/kappa,1)^alpha * max(Cr/kappa,1)^(-1.200) * 0.9938^age. kappa=0.7(F)/0.9(M), alpha=-0.241(F)/-0.302(M).

name: LDL Cholesterol Cardiovascular Ceiling
description: LDL-C must be <130 mg/dL for general population. Elevated LDL drives plaque deposition via Poiseuille's Law: ↑μ and ↓R → ↓Q. Causal pathway to vascular obstruction.
semantic_fingerprint: LDL cholesterol lipid cardiovascular Poiseuille vascular plaque atherosclerosis

derivation_formula.name: Friedewald
derivation_formula.description: Friedewald equation: LDL = T-CHO - HDL - TG/5. Valid only when TG < 400 mg/dL.

name: Fasting Glucose Metabolic Boundary
description: Fasting glucose must be 70-99 mg/dL. 100-125 = pre-diabetic; ≥126 = diabetic diagnostic threshold.
semantic_fingerprint: glucose fasting metabolic diabetes hyperglycaemia FBG blood sugar glu

name: Hepatic Marker Safety Boundary (ALT/AST)
description: ALT and AST must be within reference range. Elevated transaminases signal hepatocellular injury. AST/ALT ratio differentiates alcoholic vs non-alcoholic liver disease.
semantic_fingerprint: ALT AST liver hepatic transaminase hepatocellular SGOT SGPT

name: Hemoglobin Reference Range Compliance
description: Hemoglobin carries O2 via Fick's Principle: VO2 = CO × (CaO2 - CvO2). Must be within sex-adjusted reference range.

reasoning_chain: Flag if outside 12–17.5 g/dL normal range

name: QTc Interval Cardiac Safety Boundary
description: QTc must be <450 ms (male) or <470 ms (female). Prolonged QTc indicates risk of torsades de pointes and sudden cardiac death.
semantic_fingerprint: QTc ECG cardiac arrhythmia torsades Bazett interval

name: Framingham Cardiovascular Risk Ceiling
description: 10-year ASCVD risk must be <7.5%. Derived from age, sex, TC, HDL, SBP, smoking, diabetes status.

derivation_formula.name: Pooled_Cohort_Equations

name: Total Cholesterol Cardiovascular Ceiling (T-CHO)

name: Temporal Antecedence Gate
description: Verifies that a putative cause precedes its effect in time. A causal chain is only admissible if the exposure event (drug initiation, procedure, environmental trigger) demonstrably antedates the outcome event (adverse event, lab abnormality, clinical change). Violations indicate reverse causality or confounding.
semantic_fingerprint: temporal precedence antecedence causal timeline exposure onset sequence chronological

evidence_schema.latency_days: integer days between exposure and outcome

name: Counterfactual Consistency Check
description: Assesses whether the observed outcome would not have occurred in the absence of the exposure, using counterfactual or control group evidence. Requires documented placebo arm, historical control, or dechallenge/rechallenge data to confirm that the factor under scrutiny is necessary for the outcome.
semantic_fingerprint: counterfactual control placebo dechallenge rechallenge absence exposure necessary condition

evidence_schema.control_group_outcome: rate or severity in unexposed group
evidence_schema.exposure_group_outcome: rate or severity in exposed group

name: Confounding Variable Exclusion
description: Verifies that known confounders have been identified, measured, and adequately controlled for in the causal analysis. Residual confounding not addressed by study design (randomisation, matching, stratification) or statistical adjustment (multivariable regression, propensity scoring) invalidates a causal claim.
semantic_fingerprint: confounding confounder adjustment covariate control propensity score stratification randomisation

reasoning_chain: Flag VIOLATION if residual confounding unaddressed

name: Atherogenic Index of Plasma (AIP)
description: AIP = log10(TG/HDL). AIP < 0.11 = low cardiovascular risk; 0.11-0.21 = intermediate; > 0.21 = high. Captures lipoprotein particle size better than raw TG or HDL alone.

name: Hardy-Weinberg Equilibrium (HWE) Deviation Gate
description: Tests whether observed genotype frequencies deviate from HWE expectations using chi-square. p<0.05 flags population stratification, selection, or genotyping error — mandatory QC before GWAS.
semantic_fingerprint: HWE chi2>3.841 (p<0.05) signals genotype frequency deviation — check for population stratification, inbreeding, or batch effects before GWAS.

name: Shannon Genetic Diversity Index (H')
description: Shannon entropy H' = -Σ(p_i * ln(p_i)) quantifies allelic diversity at a locus. H'<0.5 indicates low diversity (bottleneck risk); H'>2.0 indicates high polymorphism.
semantic_fingerprint: Shannon H'<0.5 flags low genetic diversity — assess founder effect, genetic drift, or selective sweep in study population.
xai_narrator_hint: Shannon H'<0.5 flags low genetic diversity — assess founder effect, genetic drift, or selective sweep in study population.

name: Gibbs Free Energy — DNA/RNA Folding Stability (ΔG)
description: ΔG = ΔH - T·ΔS determines thermodynamic stability of nucleic acid secondary structures. ΔG < -30 kcal/mol indicates strong stable hairpin/stem-loop; critical for siRNA and CRISPR guide design.
semantic_fingerprint: ΔG>-1 kcal/mol suggests thermodynamically unstable guide/siRNA — redesign sequence or adjust salt/temperature conditions.
xai_narrator_hint: ΔG>-1 kcal/mol suggests thermodynamically unstable guide/siRNA — redesign sequence or adjust salt/temperature conditions.

name: Michaelis-Menten Enzyme Kinetics (DNA Polymerase Efficiency)
description: v = Vmax * [S] / (Km + [S]). Catalytic efficiency kcat/Km ≥ 10⁵ M⁻¹s⁻¹ is the standard threshold for biologically competent DNA polymerases and restriction enzymes.
semantic_fingerprint: kcat/Km <1e5 M⁻¹s⁻¹ indicates suboptimal enzyme — verify dNTP concentration, pH, Mg²⁺ and reaction temperature.
xai_narrator_hint: kcat/Km <1e5 M⁻¹s⁻¹ indicates suboptimal enzyme — verify dNTP concentration, pH, Mg²⁺ and reaction temperature.

name: Gompertz Tumour Growth Model (Doubling Time Gate)
description: N(t) = N0 * exp(a/b * (1 - exp(-b*t))). Tumour doubling time Td = ln(2)/b. Td < 30 days (b > 0.023/day) classifies rapid-growth tumour requiring immediate intervention.
semantic_fingerprint: Tumour Td<30 days indicates aggressive growth — escalate treatment; validate with serial imaging using RECIST 1.1.
xai_narrator_hint: Tumour Td<30 days indicates aggressive growth — escalate treatment; validate with serial imaging using RECIST 1.1.

name: Boltzmann Population Distribution — Mutation Energy Landscape
description: P(state_i) = exp(-E_i/kT) / Z quantifies the probability of a genomic state under thermal fluctuation. Used in protein folding and mutation fitness landscape modelling.
semantic_fingerprint: Boltzmann fitness P<0.5 suggests energetically unfavourable mutation state — correlate with ΔΔG protein stability predictions and population frequency.

name: Wright-Fisher Genetic Drift Index (Effective Population Size Ne)
description: Var(Δp) = p(1-p)/(2Ne). Ne < 50 triggers critical drift risk with allele fixation probability > 50% per generation — extinction/bottleneck threshold.
semantic_fingerprint: Ne<50 triggers critical drift threshold — allele fixation/loss highly probable; flag for evolutionary rescue or diversity supplementation.

name: Log-Rank Survival Difference (Kaplan-Meier Hazard Ratio Gate)
description: HR = λ_treatment / λ_control from Cox proportional hazards. HR < 0.7 with 95% CI upper bound < 1.0 defines statistically significant survival benefit for immunotherapy/gene therapy endpoints.
semantic_fingerprint: HR<0.7 with CI upper<1.0 confirms significant survival benefit — validate with KM curves, log-rank p<0.05, and median OS/PFS.

name: Hill Equation — Receptor-Drug Binding Cooperativity (EC50 Gate)
description: E = Emax * C^n / (EC50^n + C^n). Hill coefficient n>1 = positive cooperativity; EC50 is the half-maximal effective concentration. Used for CAR-T antigen density and checkpoint inhibitor binding.
semantic_fingerprint: Drug C/EC50 ratio <1 means sub-therapeutic — increase dose or investigate receptor downregulation/resistance; Hill n<0.5 suggests negative cooperativity.
